corpus_basis: All 18 records in the route-framework evidence radar are retained. One Gero et al. preprint is dated 13 April 2026 but is included because it is explicitly part of the reviewed May–August radar corpus.
limitations: Rapid-scoping seed, not a systematic review.
Route classifications are IQ Mindware/CSI interpretations, not author labels.
Some protocol/sample fields remain null or notes-only where the route review/public source did not establish them.
Risk-of-bias and body-of-evidence certainty are not yet fully appraised for every record.
